context_question: Create a YAML Deployment for nginx
question: Now add an HTTP liveness probe to the /healthz endpoint on port 8080, with initialDelaySeconds 15 and periodSeconds 20

ground_truth.answer:
Add livenessProbe to the container spec:
```yaml
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 20
```
initialDelaySeconds gives the container time to start up before the first probe runs. periodSeconds controls how frequently the probe is checked.
context: io.k8s.api.core.v1.Probe: configures a health check; fields include httpGet, initialDelaySeconds, periodSeconds, and failureThreshold
io.k8s.api.core.v1.HTTPGetAction: performs an HTTP GET to a specified path and port as the probe action
io.k8s.api.core.v1.Container: livenessProbe field defines the liveness check configuration for the container
